title: Juicy British Egg Frittata
description: A buttery and fluffy post-workout British dish featuring pickles and lacquer-glaze, this lacto-vegetarian-friendly frittata is perfect for a filling breakfast or snack.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the chopped pickles and cook until they are softened.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, lacquer-glaze, salt, and pepper.
Add the shredded cheese to the bowl and stir until combined.
Pour the egg mixture over the cooked pickles in the skillet.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle the chopped parsley on top.
Let the frittata cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
